title: Coherent colimits assembled from bounded simplicial subdiagrams
statement:
Use simplicial subsets and nondegenerate simplices as in [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set], the universes, nerves, quasicategories, coherent functors and cocones of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and the smallness, $\kappa$-smallness and $\kappa$-filteredness of [def-coef-presentable-infinity-category]. Let $\kappa$ be an uncountable regular cardinal in the smaller universe, let $K$ be a small simplicial set, and let $p:K\to\mathcal C$ be a coherent diagram in a quasicategory $\mathcal C$ admitting all small colimits. Write $I_\kappa(K)$ for the ordinary poset of simplicial subsets $L\subseteq K$ with fewer than $\kappa$ nondegenerate simplices, ordered by inclusion. This poset is small and its nerve is $\kappa$-filtered. Suppose a colimiting coherent cocone $p|_L\to q_L$ is chosen for each $L\in I_\kappa(K)$. These specified apices and cocones can be assembled into a coherent diagram
$$Q:N(I_\kappa(K))\to\mathcal C,\qquad Q(L)=q_L,$$
whose transition maps are compatible with restriction of the chosen cocones. For any colimiting cocone $p\to c$, there is a compatible coherent cocone $Q\to c$ which is colimiting. Equivalently, its comparison map
$$\operatorname{colim}_{L\in I_\kappa(K)}q_L\longrightarrow\operatorname{colim}_{K}p$$
is an equivalence. The empty simplicial subset is included in $I_\kappa(K)$, and the assertion includes $K=\varnothing$. No bound of $\kappa$ on the size of $I_\kappa(K)$ is asserted; only smallness in the fixed universe is required.

source.place: Proposition 4.2.3.4 (assembly with prescribed partial-colimit cocones), Proposition 4.2.3.8, Remark 4.2.3.9 and Corollary 4.2.3.10; the directed-union construction in the proof of Corollary 4.2.3.11, printed pp. 249-253. The stronger outer cardinal bound tau << kappa in 4.2.3.11 is unnecessary here: only universe-smallness of the indexing poset is asserted. Read online (March 10, 2012 text), not archived in literature/. No Stacks tag states this infinity-categorical result.
